messages:
jessica: Heads-up — webinar spike this morning caused ~12% handoff SLA misses in HubSpot->SF sync. Enrichment latency jumped to 3–8s for many leads and we saw claim races / owner flips. Proposal: short 'owner cooling' window (30s) after assignment + enrichment debounce before round-robin. Anyone object? :thinking:

hubspot-bot: Alert: 03:12 UTC - Lead routing queue increased 3.4x; avg enrichment time 5.2s.

diego: Agree with a cooling window. 30s seems okay but we need to check interactions with heartbeat/auto-claim on the SF connector — we could introduce backlog if we lock too long.

amy: Idea: event-level debounce — wait up to 5s for enrichment to finish before running claim logic, THEN apply a 30s cooling window only if enrichment modified owner. That reduces flips but keeps flow moving.

nora: From SDR ops: owners hate duplicate notifications. 30s is fine if we suppress owner email/pager during the cooling; otherwise they'll get two notifications for the same lead.

sam: Also flagging the round-robin pointer lock issue — current optimistic claim allows two workers to think they own the same lead when enrichment lags. Suggest a lightweight lease (Redis) for 2s during claim resolution.

jessica: Nice — combine those: 5s enrichment debounce, 2s claim lease, 30s cooling window, and suppress owner notifications while cooling. Sam — can infra estimate cost of lease ops?

sam: Tiny cost. Roughly +2 Redis ops per claim. I can prototype a checkout-and-claim flow tonight and add a feature flag `owner_cooling_v1`.

diego: Amy, can you run a short eval on false positives? If enrichment never arrives we should fallback to assign with partial data. We need to quantify unowned-lead risk.

amy: Will run a 2k-sample sim against last week's logs (enrichment timings + claim outcomes). Expect <1% extra unowned leads with 5s debounce; will report results and recommend fallback timeout.

nora: :thumbsup: Ops wants a gradual canary (1% -> 10% -> 100%) over ~4h with manual rollback points and a pre-rollout notification to SDR leads.

jessica: Action items: sam prototype + PR for lease & feature flag; amy sim & numbers by EOD; diego add fallback logic (assign with partial data after timeout); nora write suppression & canary playbook. I'll open the ticket and schedule a 30m sync if needed. Thanks all.

hubspot-bot: Ticket created: MARK-4321 - owner_cooling_v1 rollout (assigned: sam, amy, diego, nora, jessica)
